# THE CASTLE AND THE DRAGON: a walled castle on a sheer, layered mesa above a green valley and a lake, ringed by mountains, reached from a butte by a stone viaduct; a dragon circles it at sunset.
# Everything is generated by our own language. The land is one surface (a height formula of x and z: a mesa with a cliff whose strata are coloured by height, a butte, a lake, a ring of mountains), cut into
# nine material classes by height and distance. The castle is a small JavaScript builder run once per material (curtain wall with battlements, towers, the gatehouse, keep, hall, chapel, houses, the
# viaduct). The dragon (a skinned body, a lofted head with a hinged jaw, a three-part tail, two membrane wings that bend at the wrist) and its fire breath are built after.
# Metres, +y up. The mesa top is y = 95; the castle stands on it, its gate faces +z, the viaduct runs from the gate across to the butte at z = +170. Open the world with scene=open.
# kind: world
# sunset from the +x, +z side: the sun's light travels toward -x and -z, onto the gate, the faces of the towers and the dragon, with the cliff in long shadow
sky = scene.sky@1(sun_elevation=40, sun_azimuth=-58, sun_intensity=3.4, turbidity=2.4, ground_color=[0.22, 0.26, 0.24], clouds=true, cloud_cover=0.45, seed=7, haze=0.012, haze_color=[0.78, 0.85, 0.95])
env = scene.environment@1(sky_color=[0.62, 0.74, 0.92], ground_color=[0.3, 0.32, 0.28], intensity=1.0, reflection=0.4, bounce=0.4)
output sky = sky
output env = env

# ================================================= THE LAND =================================================
# h(x, z): the mesa (flat top y = 95 inside r = 60, a cliff out to r = 86, its edge made irregular by noise), the butte at (0, 170) with the same top height, the valley floor with rolling meadow and a lake
# at (-150, -20), and a ring of mountains beyond r = 210 so the world has no edge. The same formula places the trees.
let hgt = "r = sqrt(x * x + z * z); rr = r + (10.0 * perlin(vec3(x * 0.03, 1.0, z * 0.03), 3.0) + 3.0 * perlin(vec3(x * 0.15, 4.0, z * 0.15), 9.0)) * smoothstep(52.0, 75.0, r); mesa = 95.0 * (1.0 - smoothstep(60.0, 77.0, rr)); rb = sqrt(x * x + (z - 170.0) * (z - 170.0)); butte = 95.0 * (1.0 - smoothstep(26.0, 37.0, rb + (5.0 * perlin(vec3(x * 0.05, 2.0, z * 0.05), 5.0) + 2.0 * perlin(vec3(x * 0.15, 6.0, z * 0.15), 7.0)))); lk = sqrt((x + 150.0) * (x + 150.0) + (z + 20.0) * (z + 20.0)); vf0 = 2.0 + 5.0 * perlin(vec3(x * 0.01, 2.0, z * 0.01), 5.0) + 1.5 * perlin(vec3(x * 0.04, 3.0, z * 0.04), 6.0); vf = mix(vf0, -4.0, 1.0 - smoothstep(40.0, 75.0, lk)); mt = 190.0 * smoothstep(210.0, 300.0, r) * (0.55 + 0.45 * (0.5 + 0.5 * perlin(vec3(x * 0.008, 4.0, z * 0.008), 8.0))); h = max(max(mesa, butte), vf + mt);"
land_s = poly.surface_expr@1(code="w = u * 2.0 - 1.0; s = v * 2.0 - 1.0; x = sign(w) * 300.0 * (abs(w) * 0.25 + abs(w) * abs(w) * abs(w) * 0.75); z = sign(s) * 300.0 * (abs(s) * 0.25 + abs(s) * abs(s) * abs(s) * 0.75); ${hgt} out = vec3(x, h, z);", columns=300, rows=300, flip=true)
# six material classes by height and distance: lake bed, meadow, the rock of the mesa and its slopes (its strata are painted by height in the texture, so no cut edges), mountain rock, snow, the mesa top
let band = "const P = input.points, F = input.faces; const keep = new Array(P.length).fill(-1); const m = new Mesh(); for (let i = 0; i < F.length; i++) { const f = F[i]; let x = 0, y = 0, z = 0; for (let j = 0; j < f.length; j++) { x += P[f[j]][0]; y += P[f[j]][1]; z += P[f[j]][2]; } x /= f.length; y /= f.length; z /= f.length; const r = Math.hypot(x, z); let c; if (r > 150 && y > 14) c = y > 150 ? 7 : 6; else if (y < 0.5) c = 0; else if (y < 12) c = 1; else if (y < 94) c = 2; else c = 8; if (c !== K) continue; const ids = []; for (let j = 0; j < f.length; j++) { const a = f[j]; if (keep[a] < 0) keep[a] = m.vertex(P[a][0], P[a][1], P[a][2]); ids.push(keep[a]); } m.face(...ids); } m"
# a land class: its cut, its colour and its texture (hex ramp without the # in the call, the # added inside)
def landclass(k, name, r, g, b, c0, c1, tile)
  {name}_s = poly.script@1(land_s, budget=4000, code="const K = ${k}; ${band}")
  {name}_m = solid.material@1(${name}_s, color=[{r}, {g}, {b}], roughness=0.95)
  {name}_t = solid.texture@1(${name}_m, tile={tile}, size="512", program="n = fbm(scale_x=6, scale_y=6, iterations=5); s = fbm(scale_x=3, scale_y=26, iterations=4); g = colorize(n, gradient=[0:#${c0}, 1:#${c1}]); albedo = blend(colorize(s, gradient=[0:#ffffff, 1:#cfcfcf]), g, s, blend_type=multiply, amount=0.3); roughness = n; height = n")
  output land_{name} = ${name}_t
end
landclass(0, "lakebed", 0.2, 0.17, 0.13, "2a2218", "4a4032", 6)
landclass(1, "meadow", 0.3, 0.42, 0.18, "34481c", "6c7e36", 10)
# the mesa rock: horizontal strata painted by the HEIGHT of each surface point (the ochres, rusts and greys of a layered cliff), broken up by noise
rock_s = poly.script@1(land_s, budget=4000, code="const K = 2; ${band}")
rock_m = solid.material@1(rock_s, color=[0.55, 0.45, 0.36], roughness=0.95)
rock_t = solid.texture@1(rock_m, tile=16, size="512", program="hh = surface_height(low=0.0, high=95.0); n = fbm(scale_x=7, scale_y=7, iterations=5); s = fbm(scale_x=2, scale_y=30, iterations=4); strata = colorize(hh, gradient=[0:#6e5a46, 0.12:#8a7258, 0.13:#7a4f3c, 0.28:#8e5c44, 0.29:#a89070, 0.45:#c4aa82, 0.46:#6a5a4c, 0.6:#8a7864, 0.61:#9a6a50, 0.78:#b8825e, 0.79:#5a4e46, 1:#7a6a5c]); w = colorize(s, gradient=[0:#ffffff, 1:#bdb4a8]); albedo = blend(w, strata, s, blend_type=multiply, amount=0.45); roughness = n; height = s")
output land_rock = rock_t
landclass(6, "mountain", 0.38, 0.38, 0.4, "4a4a52", "88888e", 20)
landclass(7, "snow", 0.9, 0.92, 0.96, "c8d0dc", "f4f6fa", 20)
landclass(8, "mesa_top", 0.36, 0.48, 0.22, "3a5020", "7a8a3e", 8)
# the lake: dark still water over the lake bed
lake_w = water.surface@1(size=[240, 240], level=0.2, color=[0.07, 0.2, 0.24], opacity=0.88, wave_height=0.15, wave_length=9, resolution=40)
lake_a = xform.move@1(lake_w, by=[-150, 0, -20])
output lake = lake_a
# pines in the valley and on the lower slopes, placed on the ground by the same height formula; none where it is lake or steep rock (a placement scaled to 0.002, a scale must be above 0, is not seen)
tree_s = poly.script@1(code="const TAU = Math.PI * 2; const two = (m) => (...ids) => { m.face(...ids); m.face(...ids.slice().reverse()); }; const cyl = (m, x, z, y0, y1, r0, r1, n) => { const f = two(m), a = [], b = []; for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const t = TAU * i / n; a.push(m.vertex(x + r0 * Math.cos(t), y0, z + r0 * Math.sin(t))); b.push(m.vertex(x + r1 * Math.cos(t), y1, z + r1 * Math.sin(t))); } for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const j = (i + 1) % n; f(a[i], a[j], b[j], b[i]); } }; function cone(m, y0, y1, r, n) { const f = two(m), a = [], t = m.vertex(0, y1, 0); for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const q = TAU * i / n; a.push(m.vertex(r * Math.cos(q), y0, r * Math.sin(q))); } for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) f(a[i], a[(i + 1) % n], t); } const m = new Mesh(); cyl(m, 0, 0, 0, 1.3, 0.22, 0.16, 5); cone(m, 0.8, 4.8, 2.0, 6); cone(m, 2.8, 6.4, 1.6, 6); cone(m, 4.6, 7.8, 1.15, 6); m")
tree_m = solid.material@1(tree_s, color=[0.13, 0.27, 0.13], roughness=0.9)
tree_t = solid.texture@1(tree_m, tile=9, size="256", program="n = fbm(scale_x=6, scale_y=6, iterations=4); albedo = colorize(n, gradient=[0:#16301a, 0.5:#27471f, 1:#4a6a2a]); roughness = n; height = n")
let treepos = "a = fract(sin(i * 12.9898 + 1.3) * 43758.5453); b = fract(sin(i * 78.233 + 5.1) * 43758.5453); an = b * 6.2831853; rad = 100.0 + a * 120.0; x = rad * cos(an); z = rad * sin(an);"
trees = inst.program@1(tree_t, count=1100, code="${treepos} ${hgt} out = vec3(x, h - 0.4, z);", scale_code="${treepos} ${hgt} out = 0.002 + step(0.8, h) * (1.0 - step(30.0, h)) * (0.9 + 1.1 * fract(sin(i * 4.37) * 9731.3));", yaw_code="out = fract(sin(i * 9.1) * 1234.5) * 360.0")
output trees = trees

# ================================================= THE CASTLE =================================================
# One builder (JavaScript, run once per material). World coordinates, the mesa top at Y0 = 95. A box, a frustum, a cone, a gable roof (ridge along its local x, yawed) are the only primitives; every
# face is two-sided so winding never matters for these props. The curtain wall is a 28-sided ring at r = 50 (the two segments at the gate are left out for the gatehouse), seven round towers, the gatehouse
# at +z, the keep at the middle, a hall, a chapel with a spired bell tower, nine houses, and the viaduct.
let cas = "const TAU = Math.PI * 2, Y0 = 95, R = 50, N = 28; const hash = (n) => { const s = Math.sin(n * 12.9898 + 4.1414) * 43758.5453; return s - Math.floor(s); }; const two = (m) => (...ids) => { m.face(...ids); m.face(...ids.slice().reverse()); }; const boxY = (m, cx, cy, cz, sx, sy, sz, yaw) => { const f = two(m), c = Math.cos(yaw), s = Math.sin(yaw), v = []; for (const dy of [-0.5, 0.5]) for (const q of [[-0.5, -0.5], [0.5, -0.5], [0.5, 0.5], [-0.5, 0.5]]) { const lx = q[0] * sx, lz = q[1] * sz; v.push(m.vertex(cx + lx * c + lz * s, cy + dy * sy, cz - lx * s + lz * c)); } f(v[0], v[1], v[2], v[3]); f(v[4], v[5], v[6], v[7]); f(v[0], v[1], v[5], v[4]); f(v[1], v[2], v[6], v[5]); f(v[2], v[3], v[7], v[6]); f(v[3], v[0], v[4], v[7]); }; const cyl = (m, x, z, y0, y1, r0, r1, n) => { const f = two(m), a = [], b = []; for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const t = TAU * i / n; a.push(m.vertex(x + r0 * Math.cos(t), y0, z + r0 * Math.sin(t))); b.push(m.vertex(x + r1 * Math.cos(t), y1, z + r1 * Math.sin(t))); } const apex = r1 < 0.01 ? m.vertex(x, y1, z) : null; for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const j = (i + 1) % n; if (apex !== null) f(a[i], a[j], apex); else f(a[i], a[j], b[j], b[i]); } f(...a); if (apex === null) f(...b); }; const gable = (m, cx, cy, cz, len, wid, rh, yaw) => { const f = two(m), c = Math.cos(yaw), s = Math.sin(yaw), L = len / 2 + 0.6, Wd = wid / 2 + 0.6; const v = (lx, y, lz) => m.vertex(cx + lx * c + lz * s, y, cz - lx * s + lz * c); const a0 = v(-L, cy, -Wd), a1 = v(L, cy, -Wd), b0 = v(-L, cy, Wd), b1 = v(L, cy, Wd), r0 = v(-L, cy + rh, 0), r1 = v(L, cy + rh, 0); f(a0, a1, r1, r0); f(b0, r0, r1, b1); f(a0, r0, b0); f(a1, b1, r1); }; const pyr = (m, cx, cy, cz, sx, h) => { const f = two(m); const a = m.vertex(cx - sx, cy, cz - sx), b = m.vertex(cx + sx, cy, cz - sx), c = m.vertex(cx + sx, cy, cz + sx), d = m.vertex(cx - sx, cy, cz + sx), t = m.vertex(cx, cy + h, cz); f(a, b, t); f(b, c, t); f(c, d, t); f(d, a, t); }; const TW = [0, 45, 135, 180, 225, 270, 315].map((d) => [R * Math.cos(d * Math.PI / 180), R * Math.sin(d * Math.PI / 180)]); const HS = [[-30, -25, 0.3, 8, 7, 6, 3.2], [-18, -34, -0.2, 7, 6, 5.5, 3], [12, -33, 0.1, 8, 7, 6.5, 3.4], [34, 10, 1.2, 7, 8, 6, 3], [36, -28, 0.6, 8, 6, 5.5, 3], [-38, -2, 1.5, 7, 8, 6.5, 3.4], [-10, 28, 0, 7, 6, 5, 2.8], [14, 24, 0.5, 8, 7, 6, 3], [-36, 30, -0.5, 7, 6, 5.5, 3]]; function walls() { const m = new Mesh(); for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) { if (i === 6 || i === 7) continue; const a0 = TAU * i / N, a1 = TAU * (i + 1) / N, am = (a0 + a1) / 2; const x0 = R * Math.cos(a0), z0 = R * Math.sin(a0), x1 = R * Math.cos(a1), z1 = R * Math.sin(a1), dx = x1 - x0, dz = z1 - z0, L = Math.hypot(dx, dz), yaw = Math.atan2(-dz, dx), mx = (x0 + x1) / 2, mz = (z0 + z1) / 2; boxY(m, mx, Y0 + 5.5, mz, L + 0.2, 11, 3.2, yaw); const n = Math.floor(L / 2.4); for (let k = 0; k < n; k++) { const t = (k + 0.5) / n - 0.5; boxY(m, mx + dx * t + Math.cos(am) * 1.1, Y0 + 11.9, mz + dz * t + Math.sin(am) * 1.1, 1.3, 1.6, 1.0, yaw); } } return m; } function towers(kind) { const m = new Mesh(); for (const p of TW) { if (kind === 0) { cyl(m, p[0], p[1], Y0, Y0 + 20, 5.4, 5.2, 18); cyl(m, p[0], p[1], Y0 + 20, Y0 + 21.8, 6.4, 6.4, 18); } if (kind === 1) cyl(m, p[0], p[1], Y0 + 21.8, Y0 + 34, 7.0, 0, 18); if (kind === 2) for (const y of [8, 15]) for (let k = 0; k < 4; k++) { const a = TAU * k / 4 + 0.4, rx = Math.cos(a), rz = Math.sin(a); boxY(m, p[0] + rx * 5.3, Y0 + y, p[1] + rz * 5.3, 0.5, 1.6, 0.5, -a); } } return m; } function gate(kind) { const m = new Mesh(); const zc = R; if (kind === 0) { for (const s of [-1, 1]) { boxY(m, s * 8.5, Y0 + 13, zc, 7, 26, 9, 0); boxY(m, s * 3.75, Y0 + 9.5, zc, 2.5, 19, 9, 0); for (let k = 0; k < 4; k++) boxY(m, s * 8.5, Y0 + 26.8, zc - 3.4 + k * 2.27, 1.2, 1.6, 1.2, 0); } boxY(m, 0, Y0 + 14.3, zc, 5, 11.5, 9, 0); for (let k = 0; k < 4; k++) for (const s of [-1, 1]) boxY(m, s * 6.2, Y0 + 20.2, zc + 4.9, 1.3, 1.6, 1.2, 0); } if (kind === 1) for (const s of [-1, 1]) pyr(m, s * 8.5, Y0 + 26, zc, 4.6, 11); if (kind === 2) { boxY(m, 0, Y0 + 3.75, zc - 0.5, 5, 7.5, 8, 0); for (let k = 0; k < 9; k++) boxY(m, -2.1 + k * 0.52, Y0 + 3.9, zc + 4.7, 0.12, 7.4, 0.12, 0); for (let k = 0; k < 6; k++) boxY(m, 0, Y0 + 1 + k * 1.2, zc + 4.7, 4.8, 0.1, 0.1, 0); } return m; } function keep(kind) { const m = new Mesh(); const cs = [[-10, -10], [10, -10], [10, 10], [-10, 10]]; if (kind === 0) { boxY(m, 0, Y0 + 23, 0, 20, 46, 20, 0); for (const c of cs) cyl(m, c[0], c[1], Y0, Y0 + 54, 3.4, 3.2, 14); for (let k = 0; k < 8; k++) { const t = -8.4 + k * 2.4; boxY(m, t, Y0 + 47, 10, 1.3, 1.6, 1.2, 0); boxY(m, t, Y0 + 47, -10, 1.3, 1.6, 1.2, 0); boxY(m, 10, Y0 + 47, t, 1.2, 1.6, 1.3, 0); boxY(m, -10, Y0 + 47, t, 1.2, 1.6, 1.3, 0); } } if (kind === 1) for (const c of cs) cyl(m, c[0], c[1], Y0 + 54, Y0 + 66, 4.3, 0, 14); return m; } function hall(kind) { const m = new Mesh(); if (kind === 0) boxY(m, -24, Y0 + 7, 14, 28, 14, 14, 0); if (kind === 1) gable(m, -24, Y0 + 14, 14, 28, 14, 7, 0); return m; } function chapel(kind) { const m = new Mesh(); if (kind === 0) { boxY(m, 26, Y0 + 6, -12, 12, 12, 22, 0); boxY(m, 26, Y0 + 15, -25, 6, 30, 6, 0); } if (kind === 1) { gable(m, 26, Y0 + 12, -12, 22, 12, 6.5, Math.PI / 2); } if (kind === 2) cyl(m, 26, -25, Y0 + 30, Y0 + 46, 4.4, 0, 8); return m; } function houses(kind) { const m = new Mesh(); for (const h of HS) { if (kind === 0) boxY(m, h[0], Y0 + h[5] / 2, h[1], h[3], h[5], h[4], h[2]); if (kind === 1) gable(m, h[0], Y0 + h[5], h[1], h[3], h[4], h[6], h[2]); } return m; } function windows(lit) { const m = new Mesh(); const add = (cx, cy, cz, sx, sy, sz, yaw, on) => { if (on === lit) boxY(m, cx, cy, cz, sx, sy, sz, yaw); }; for (let r = 0; r < 3; r++) for (let c = -1; c <= 1; c++) { const y = Y0 + 14 + 10 * r, o = hash(r * 7 + c + 3) > 0.35; add(c * 5, y, 10.05, 1.1, 2.0, 0.2, 0, o); add(c * 5, y, -10.05, 1.1, 2.0, 0.2, 0, hash(r + c * 5) > 0.35); add(10.05, y, c * 5, 0.2, 2.0, 1.1, 0, hash(r * 3 + c) > 0.35); add(-10.05, y, c * 5, 0.2, 2.0, 1.1, 0, hash(r * 5 + c + 9) > 0.35); } for (let k = 0; k < 5; k++) add(-34 + k * 5.2, Y0 + 6.5, 21.05, 1.4, 3.6, 0.2, 0, true); for (let k = 0; k < 4; k++) for (const s of [-1, 1]) add(26 + s * 6.05, Y0 + 6.5, -6 - k * 4.5, 0.2, 3.4, 1.2, 0, true); for (const h of HS) for (const s of [-1, 1]) { const c = Math.cos(h[2]), sn = Math.sin(h[2]), lz = h[4] / 2 + 0.05, lx = s * h[3] * 0.24; add(h[0] + lx * c + lz * sn, Y0 + h[5] * 0.55, h[1] - lx * sn + lz * c, 1.0, 1.5, 0.15, h[2], hash(h[0] + s) > 0.3); } return m; } function bridge() { const m = new Mesh(); const Z0 = 54.5, S = 20, P = 3.8, ys = 80, yd = 92; for (let s = 0; s < 4; s++) { const z0 = Z0 + s * (S + P), zc = z0 + S / 2; const n = 16, dz = S / n; for (let k = 0; k < n; k++) { const zk = z0 + (k + 0.5) * dz, dd = zk - zc, yb = ys + Math.sqrt(Math.max(0, 100 - dd * dd)); if (yd - yb > 0.2) boxY(m, 0, (yb + yd) / 2, zk, 7, yd - yb, dz + 0.02, 0); } if (s < 3) boxY(m, 0, 40 + 5, z0 + S + P / 2, 7, 90, P, 0); } boxY(m, 0, Y0 - 1.5, Z0 + 46, 8, 3, 92, 0); for (let k = 0; k < 9; k++) for (const sx of [-3.7, 3.7]) boxY(m, sx, Y0 + 1.1, Z0 + 5.1 + k * 10.1, 0.6, 2.2, 10, 0); return m; }"

# a textured castle part: its builder call, a colour and a tiled procedural surface (hex ramp without the #, the # added inside)
let stone = "b = bricks(rows=8, columns=3, row_offset=0.5, mortar=0.05, bevel=0.15); n = fbm(scale_x=5, scale_y=5, iterations=4); stonec = colorize(b, gradient=[0:#2e2a26, 0.5:#2e2a26, 0.52:#7d776c, 1:#a8a194]); tint = colorize(n, gradient=[0:#b9b0a0, 1:#ffffff]); albedo = blend(tint, stonec, n, blend_type=multiply, amount=0.5); height = b; roughness = colorize(b, gradient=[0:#f0f0f0, 1:#d8d8d8])"
def cpart(name, call, r, g, b, c0, c1, tile)
  {name}_s = poly.script@1(code="${cas} ${call}")
  {name}_m = solid.material@1(${name}_s, color=[{r}, {g}, {b}], roughness=0.85)
  {name}_t = solid.texture@1(${name}_m, tile={tile}, size="256", program="n = fbm(scale_x=5, scale_y=5, iterations=5); s = fbm(scale_x=2, scale_y=10, iterations=3); c = colorize(n, gradient=[0:#${c0}, 1:#${c1}]); d = colorize(s, gradient=[0:#ffffff, 1:#cfc6b4]); albedo = blend(d, c, s, blend_type=multiply, amount=0.35); roughness = n; height = s")
  output {name} = ${name}_t
end
def cstone(name, call, r, g, b)
  {name}_s = poly.script@1(code="${cas} ${call}")
  {name}_m = solid.material@1(${name}_s, color=[{r}, {g}, {b}], roughness=0.9)
  {name}_t = solid.texture@1(${name}_m, tile=4, size="512", program="${stone}")
  output {name} = ${name}_t
end
def cplain(name, call, r, g, b, met, rgh)
  {name}_s = poly.script@1(code="${cas} ${call}")
  {name}_m = solid.material@1(${name}_s, color=[{r}, {g}, {b}], metallic={met}, roughness={rgh})
  output {name} = ${name}_m
end
def cglow(name, call, r, g, b, er, eg, eb)
  {name}_s = poly.script@1(code="${cas} ${call}")
  {name}_m = solid.material@1(${name}_s, color=[{r}, {g}, {b}], roughness=0.3, emissive=[{er}, {eg}, {eb}])
  output {name} = ${name}_m
end
cstone("castle_walls", "walls()", 0.56, 0.54, 0.5)
cstone("castle_towers", "towers(0)", 0.58, 0.56, 0.52)
cpart("tower_roofs", "towers(1)", 0.3, 0.34, 0.44, "3a4458", "6c7a92", 3)
cplain("tower_slits", "towers(2)", 0.03, 0.03, 0.04, 0.0, 0.8)
cstone("gatehouse", "gate(0)", 0.6, 0.58, 0.54)
cpart("gate_roofs", "gate(1)", 0.3, 0.34, 0.44, "3a4458", "6c7a92", 3)
cplain("gate_iron", "gate(2)", 0.05, 0.05, 0.06, 0.6, 0.5)
cstone("keep", "keep(0)", 0.62, 0.6, 0.56)
cpart("keep_roofs", "keep(1)", 0.3, 0.34, 0.44, "3a4458", "6c7a92", 3)
cstone("great_hall", "hall(0)", 0.6, 0.57, 0.5)
cpart("great_hall_roof", "hall(1)", 0.5, 0.26, 0.2, "8a3a28", "c4684a", 3)
cstone("chapel", "chapel(0)", 0.66, 0.64, 0.6)
cpart("chapel_roof", "chapel(1)", 0.3, 0.34, 0.44, "3a4458", "6c7a92", 3)
cplain("chapel_spire", "chapel(2)", 0.3, 0.55, 0.48, 0.5, 0.5)
cpart("houses", "houses(0)", 0.9, 0.85, 0.72, "ede2c8", "cdbf9c", 5)
cpart("house_roofs", "houses(1)", 0.5, 0.26, 0.2, "8a3a28", "c4684a", 3)
cglow("windows_lit", "windows(true)", 1.0, 0.8, 0.5, 3.6, 2.3, 0.9)
cplain("windows_dark", "windows(false)", 0.05, 0.07, 0.1, 0.2, 0.1)
cstone("viaduct", "bridge()", 0.56, 0.54, 0.5)
# the courtyard: cobbles over the mesa top inside the wall
court_c = solid.cylinder@1(radius=56, height=0.3, segments=48)
court_a = xform.move@1(court_c, by=[0, 95.05, 0])
court_m = solid.material@1(court_a, color=[0.5, 0.47, 0.42], roughness=0.85)
court_t = solid.texture@1(court_m, tile=6, size="512", program="b = bricks_uneven4(x=12, y=12, randomness=0.6, mortar=0.12, bevel=0.25); n = fbm(scale_x=6, scale_y=6, iterations=4); c = colorize(b, gradient=[0:#25221e, 0.04:#25221e, 0.1:#6c665c, 1:#a59d8e]); t = colorize(n, gradient=[0:#c8bca8, 1:#ffffff]); albedo = blend(t, c, n, blend_type=multiply, amount=0.5); height = b; roughness = colorize(b, gradient=[0:#f0f0f0, 1:#d0d0d0])")
output courtyard = court_t

# ================================================= THE DRAGON =================================================
# About 20 m from snout to tail tip with a 40 m span, in its own coordinates (+z forward, y up, +x the left wing), built at the origin and flown by the path track below. Hierarchy (as for the eagle):
# dragon_body (flies the circle) > wings (the inner arm flaps at the shoulder, the hand bends at the wrist behind it) , head (sways) > jaw (opens to breathe) > fire, and three tail pieces in a chain
# (each swings a little more and a little later than the one before, so the tail snakes).
# jd: shared helpers: a two-sided tube along a polyline, a cone, an oval loft along z from a key table (z, top, bottom, half width), a membrane patch (a triangle grid sagging between three points).
let jd = "const TAU = Math.PI * 2; const two = (m) => (...ids) => { m.face(...ids); m.face(...ids.slice().reverse()); }; const tube = (m, pts, rad, sides) => { const f = two(m), rings = []; for (let i = 0; i < pts.length; i++) { const a = pts[Math.max(0, i - 1)], b = pts[Math.min(pts.length - 1, i + 1)]; let d = [b[0] - a[0], b[1] - a[1], b[2] - a[2]]; const dl = Math.hypot(d[0], d[1], d[2]) || 1; d = [d[0] / dl, d[1] / dl, d[2] / dl]; const u = Math.abs(d[1]) < 0.9 ? [0, 1, 0] : [1, 0, 0]; let r = [d[1] * u[2] - d[2] * u[1], d[2] * u[0] - d[0] * u[2], d[0] * u[1] - d[1] * u[0]]; const rl = Math.hypot(r[0], r[1], r[2]) || 1; r = [r[0] / rl, r[1] / rl, r[2] / rl]; const w = [d[1] * r[2] - d[2] * r[1], d[2] * r[0] - d[0] * r[2], d[0] * r[1] - d[1] * r[0]]; const row = []; for (let j = 0; j < sides; j++) { const p = j / sides * TAU, c = Math.cos(p) * rad[i], s = Math.sin(p) * rad[i]; row.push(m.vertex(pts[i][0] + r[0] * c + w[0] * s, pts[i][1] + r[1] * c + w[1] * s, pts[i][2] + r[2] * c + w[2] * s)); } rings.push(row); } for (let i = 0; i + 1 < pts.length; i++) for (let j = 0; j < sides; j++) { const j2 = (j + 1) % sides; f(rings[i][j], rings[i + 1][j], rings[i + 1][j2], rings[i][j2]); } }; const cone = (m, p, d, r, L, n) => { const f = two(m); let t = [d[0], d[1], d[2]]; const tl = Math.hypot(t[0], t[1], t[2]) || 1; t = [t[0] / tl, t[1] / tl, t[2] / tl]; const u = Math.abs(t[1]) < 0.9 ? [0, 1, 0] : [1, 0, 0]; let a = [t[1] * u[2] - t[2] * u[1], t[2] * u[0] - t[0] * u[2], t[0] * u[1] - t[1] * u[0]]; const al = Math.hypot(a[0], a[1], a[2]) || 1; a = [a[0] / al, a[1] / al, a[2] / al]; const b = [t[1] * a[2] - t[2] * a[1], t[2] * a[0] - t[0] * a[2], t[0] * a[1] - t[1] * a[0]]; const tip = m.vertex(p[0] + t[0] * L, p[1] + t[1] * L, p[2] + t[2] * L); const ring = []; for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const q = i / n * TAU, c = Math.cos(q) * r, s = Math.sin(q) * r; ring.push(m.vertex(p[0] + a[0] * c + b[0] * s, p[1] + a[1] * c + b[1] * s, p[2] + a[2] * c + b[2] * s)); } for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) f(ring[i], ring[(i + 1) % n], tip); }; const loft = (m, K, ox, oy, oz) => { const at = (z, c) => { let i = 0; while (i < K.length - 2 && z > K[i + 1][0]) i++; const a = K[i], b = K[i + 1]; let t = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (z - a[0]) / (b[0] - a[0]))); t = (1 - Math.cos(Math.PI * t)) / 2; return a[c] + (b[c] - a[c]) * t; }; const N = 26, M = 16, f = two(m), ids = []; const z0 = K[0][0], z1 = K[K.length - 1][0]; for (let i = 0; i <= N; i++) { const z = z0 + (z1 - z0) * i / N, top = at(z, 1), bot = at(z, 2), w = at(z, 3), yc = (top + bot) / 2, h = (top - bot) / 2, row = []; for (let j = 0; j < M; j++) { const p = j / M * TAU, c = Math.cos(p), s = Math.sin(p); row.push(m.vertex(ox + w * Math.sign(c) * Math.pow(Math.abs(c), 0.8), oy + yc + h * Math.sign(s) * Math.pow(Math.abs(s), 0.9), oz + z)); } ids.push(row); } for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) for (let j = 0; j < M; j++) { const j2 = (j + 1) % M; f(ids[i][j], ids[i + 1][j], ids[i + 1][j2], ids[i][j2]); } f(...ids[0]); f(...ids[N]); return at; }; const patch = (m, A, B, C, n, sag) => { const f = two(m), V = []; for (let i = 0; i <= n; i++) { const row = []; for (let j = 0; j <= n - i; j++) { const b = i / n, c = j / n, a = 1 - b - c; const k = sag * 27 * a * b * c; row.push(m.vertex(A[0] * a + B[0] * b + C[0] * c, A[1] * a + B[1] * b + C[1] * c - k, A[2] * a + B[2] * b + C[2] * c)); } V.push(row); } for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) for (let j = 0; j < n - i; j++) { f(V[i][j], V[i + 1][j], V[i][j + 1]); if (j < n - i - 1) f(V[i + 1][j], V[i + 1][j + 1], V[i][j + 1]); } }; const OH = [0, 3.4, 7.4]; const KH = [[-0.6, 0.5, -0.55, 0.6], [0, 0.78, -0.6, 0.8], [0.7, 0.9, -0.5, 0.88], [1.3, 0.78, -0.34, 0.72], [2.0, 0.56, -0.24, 0.52], [2.7, 0.4, -0.18, 0.38], [3.3, 0.28, -0.12, 0.28]]; const KJ = [[0.2, -0.4, -0.82, 0.6], [1.0, -0.36, -0.78, 0.56], [1.9, -0.28, -0.58, 0.4], [2.7, -0.2, -0.42, 0.28], [3.2, -0.14, -0.3, 0.2]]; function skull() { const m = new Mesh(); loft(m, KH, OH[0], OH[1], OH[2]); return m; } function jaw() { const m = new Mesh(); loft(m, KJ, OH[0], OH[1], OH[2]); return m; } function teeth(lower) { const m = new Mesh(); const K = lower ? KJ : KH; const at = (z, c) => { let i = 0; while (i < K.length - 2 && z > K[i + 1][0]) i++; const a = K[i], b = K[i + 1]; const t = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (z - a[0]) / (b[0] - a[0]))); return a[c] + (b[c] - a[c]) * t; }; for (let k = 0; k < 11; k++) { const z = (lower ? 0.9 : 0.8) + k * 0.2 + (k % 2) * 0.02; for (const s of [-1, 1]) { const hw = at(z, 3) * 0.86, y = lower ? at(z, 1) - 0.02 : at(z, 2) + 0.02, L = (k % 3 === 0 ? 0.34 : 0.22); cone(m, [OH[0] + s * hw, OH[1] + y, OH[2] + z], [0, lower ? 1 : -1, 0.15], 0.055, L, 5); } } return m; } function horns() { const m = new Mesh(); for (const s of [-1, 1]) { const P = [[0.45, 0.7, 0.2], [0.75, 1.2, -0.5], [1.05, 1.7, -1.4], [1.25, 2.05, -2.4], [1.2, 2.2, -3.3]].map((p) => [OH[0] + s * p[0], OH[1] + p[1], OH[2] + p[2]]); tube(m, P, [0.22, 0.18, 0.12, 0.07, 0.015], 8); const Q = [[0.82, -0.05, 0.1], [1.3, -0.2, -0.5], [1.75, -0.45, -1.2]].map((p) => [OH[0] + s * p[0], OH[1] + p[1], OH[2] + p[2]]); tube(m, Q, [0.13, 0.09, 0.015], 6); for (let k = 0; k < 3; k++) cone(m, [OH[0] + s * 0.5, OH[1] + 0.82 - k * 0.0, OH[2] + 1.2 + k * 0.45], [s * 0.4, 1, -0.4], 0.07, 0.4, 5); } return m; } function wing(kind, s) { const m = new Mesh(); const X = (p) => [s * p[0], p[1], p[2]]; const S = X([1.3, 1.7, 2.8]), E = X([5.5, 2.6, 0.6]), Wr = X([10.5, 4.2, 3.6]), F = [[20, 3.0, 0.5], [19, -1.2, -5.5], [15.5, -3.8, -9.5], [11, -4.8, -10.5]].map(X), H = X([1.2, 0.3, -3.2]); if (kind === 0) { tube(m, [S, E], [0.42, 0.32], 8); tube(m, [E, Wr], [0.32, 0.22], 8); cone(m, Wr, [s * 0.5, 0.6, 1], 0.14, 1.3, 6); } if (kind === 1) for (const t of F) { const mid = [(Wr[0] + t[0]) / 2, (Wr[1] + t[1]) / 2 + 0.7, (Wr[2] + t[2]) / 2]; tube(m, [Wr, mid, t], [0.2, 0.12, 0.03], 6); } if (kind === 2) { patch(m, S, E, H, 8, 0.4); patch(m, E, F[3], H, 8, 0.35); patch(m, E, Wr, F[3], 8, 0.35); } if (kind === 3) { patch(m, Wr, F[0], F[1], 10, 0.4); patch(m, Wr, F[1], F[2], 10, 0.4); patch(m, Wr, F[2], F[3], 10, 0.4); } return m; } function spikes() { const m = new Mesh(); const J = [[3.3, 7.3, 0.56], [2.7, 6.2, 0.66], [1.8, 5.3, 0.8], [0.9, 4.0, 1.0], [0.1, 1.6, 1.6], [-0.1, -0.8, 1.5], [0, -3, 1.3]]; for (let k = 0; k < J.length - 1; k++) for (let q = 0; q < 2; q++) { const t = q / 2, y = J[k][0] + (J[k + 1][0] - J[k][0]) * t, z = J[k][1] + (J[k + 1][1] - J[k][1]) * t, r = J[k][2] + (J[k + 1][2] - J[k][2]) * t; cone(m, [0, y + r * 0.9, z], [0, 1, -0.55], 0.2 + 0.06 * (J.length - k) * 0.4, 0.55 + 0.08 * (J.length - k), 6); } return m; } function claws() { const m = new Mesh(); for (const s of [-1, 1]) { for (const e of [[1.5, -2.5, 3.7], [1.5, -2.3, -5.3]]) for (let k = -1; k <= 1; k++) cone(m, [s * (e[0] + k * 0.22), e[1] - 0.1, e[2] + 0.1], [0.05 * k, -0.5, 1], 0.1, 0.55, 5); } return m; } function blade() { const m = new Mesh(); const f = two(m); const a = m.vertex(0, 0.4, -19), b = m.vertex(1.5, 0.4, -20.6), c = m.vertex(0, 0.4, -23), d = m.vertex(-1.5, 0.4, -20.6); f(a, b, c); f(a, c, d); return m; }"

# a dragon part: a builder call, its colour (and the hide's scales or the membrane's veins as a texture) and, if it has a parent, its parent
def dpart(name, call, r, g, b, met, rgh, par)
  {name}_s = poly.script@1(code="${jd} ${call}")
  {name}_m = solid.material@1(${name}_s, color=[{r}, {g}, {b}], metallic={met}, roughness={rgh})
  {name}_p = anim.parent@1(${name}_m, parent="${par}")
  output {name} = ${name}_p
end
let scales = "b = beehive(sx=26, sy=26); c = colorize(b, gradient=[0:#100a08, 0.12:#100a08, 0.18:#5a1810, 1:#9c3a1e]); n = fbm(scale_x=3, scale_y=3, iterations=4); k = colorize(n, gradient=[0:#ffffff, 1:#c8b8a8]); albedo = blend(k, c, n, blend_type=multiply, amount=0.5); height = b; roughness = colorize(b, gradient=[0:#f0f0f0, 1:#b0b0b0])"
let leather = "n = fbm(noise=cellular, scale_x=7, scale_y=7, iterations=3); w = fbm(scale_x=3, scale_y=3, iterations=4); v = colorize(n, gradient=[0:#2a0c0a, 0.2:#4a1612, 1:#8a3626]); albedo = blend(colorize(w, gradient=[0:#ffffff, 1:#d0b8a8]), v, w, blend_type=multiply, amount=0.4); roughness = w; height = n"

def dleather(name, call, par)
  {name}_s = poly.script@1(code="${jd} ${call}")
  {name}_m = solid.material@1(${name}_s, color=[0.45, 0.12, 0.1], roughness=0.6)
  {name}_t = solid.texture@1(${name}_m, tile=3, size="512", program="${leather}")
  {name}_p = anim.parent@1(${name}_t, parent="${par}")
  output {name} = ${name}_p
end

# ---- the body: one skinned surface (hips, belly, chest, a four-joint neck, tucked fore and hind legs), subdivided; the path track below flies it ----
dr_s = poly.skin@1(joints="hip 0 0 -3 1.3 1.2 root; belly 0 -0.1 -0.8 1.5 1.35; chest 0 0.1 1.6 1.6 1.5; n1 0 0.9 4.0 1.0 1.0; n2 0 1.8 5.3 0.8 0.8; n3 0 2.7 6.2 0.66 0.66; n4 0 3.3 7.3 0.56 0.56; fl0 2.3 -0.9 2.2 0.55 0.55; fl1 2.5 -2.0 2.8 0.38 0.38; fl2 2.3 -2.8 3.8 0.28 0.28; hl0 2.0 -0.9 -2.7 0.75 0.75; hl1 2.3 -2.1 -3.4 0.5 0.5; hl2 2.1 -2.4 -5.3 0.3 0.3", bones="hip-belly; belly-chest; chest-n1; n1-n2; n2-n3; n3-n4; chest-fl0; fl0-fl1; fl1-fl2; hip-hl0; hl0-hl1; hl1-hl2", symmetry="x")
dr_d = poly.subdivide@1(dr_s, levels=2)
dr_m = solid.material@1(dr_d, color=[0.4, 0.09, 0.06], roughness=0.55)
dr_t = solid.texture@1(dr_m, tile=2.2, size="512", program="${scales}")
# the flight: a circle of 85 m radius round the castle at 135 m, one lap in 36 s, heading along it, banked into the turn, bobbing with each wingbeat
let lap = join(k in 0..13, "{k * 3}:{-85 * cos(k * 0.5235988)},{135 + 3 * sin(k * 1.5707963)},{85 * sin(k * 0.5235988)}", "; ")
let yaw = join(k in 0..13, "{k * 3}:0,{k * 30},-14", "; ")
dr_r = anim.track@1(dr_t, property="rotation", keys="${yaw}", interpolation="linear")
dr_p = anim.track@1(dr_r, property="position", keys="${lap}", interpolation="bezier")
output dragon_body = dr_p
# the tail: three skinned pieces in a chain
def tailpiece(name, joints, bones, piv, amp, ph, par)
  {name}_k = poly.skin@1(joints="${joints}", bones="${bones}", symmetry="none")
  {name}_d = poly.subdivide@1(${name}_k, levels=2)
  {name}_m = solid.material@1(${name}_d, color=[0.4, 0.09, 0.06], roughness=0.55)
  {name}_t = solid.texture@1(${name}_m, tile=2.2, size="512", program="${scales}")
  {name}_w = anim.wave@1(${name}_t, property="rotation", amplitude=[{amp * 0.3}, {amp}, 0], period=4.8, phase={ph}, pivot=[${piv}])
  {name}_p = anim.parent@1(${name}_w, parent="${par}")
  output {name} = ${name}_p
end
tailpiece("dragon_tail_a", "a0 0 0 -2.6 1.1 1.0 root; a1 0 -0.15 -5.4 0.9 0.8; a2 0 -0.25 -8.2 0.62 0.58", "a0-a1; a1-a2", "0, 0, -2.6", 6, 0.0, "dragon_body")
tailpiece("dragon_tail_b", "b0 0 -0.25 -7.8 0.7 0.65 root; b1 0 -0.1 -10.6 0.52 0.48; b2 0 0.05 -13.2 0.4 0.37", "b0-b1; b1-b2", "0, -0.25, -7.8", 9, 0.12, "dragon_tail_a")
tailpiece("dragon_tail_c", "c0 0 0.0 -12.8 0.46 0.42 root; c1 0 0.2 -16 0.3 0.28; c2 0 0.4 -19 0.12 0.1", "c0-c1; c1-c2", "0, 0, -12.8", 14, 0.24, "dragon_tail_b")
dpart("dragon_tail_blade", "blade()", 0.32, 0.07, 0.05, 0.0, 0.6, "dragon_tail_c")
# the dorsal spikes and claws
dpart("dragon_spikes", "spikes()", 0.12, 0.08, 0.07, 0.0, 0.6, "dragon_body")
dpart("dragon_claws", "claws()", 0.85, 0.8, 0.66, 0.0, 0.5, "dragon_body")
# the head sways a little; the horns, teeth and eyes follow it; the jaw hangs from it and opens (22 degrees, for three seconds in every nine) to breathe
dh_s = poly.script@1(code="${jd} skull()")
dh_m = solid.material@1(dh_s, color=[0.4, 0.09, 0.06], roughness=0.55)
dh_t = solid.texture@1(dh_m, tile=2.2, size="512", program="${scales}")
dh_w = anim.wave@1(dh_t, property="rotation", amplitude=[2, 9, 0], period=6, pivot=[0, 3.2, 7.2])
dh_p = anim.parent@1(dh_w, parent="dragon_body")
output dragon_head = dh_p
dpart("dragon_horns", "horns()", 0.85, 0.8, 0.66, 0.0, 0.45, "dragon_head")
dpart("dragon_teeth_upper", "teeth(false)", 0.95, 0.93, 0.85, 0.0, 0.3, "dragon_head")
dj_s = poly.script@1(code="${jd} jaw()")
dj_m = solid.material@1(dj_s, color=[0.34, 0.07, 0.05], roughness=0.55)
dj_a = anim.track@1(dj_m, property="rotation", keys="0:0,0,0; 2.2:0,0,0; 2.7:22,0,0; 5.2:22,0,0; 5.7:0,0,0; 9:0,0,0", interpolation="smooth", pivot=[0, 3.05, 7.8])
dj_p = anim.parent@1(dj_a, parent="dragon_head")
output dragon_jaw = dj_p
dpart("dragon_teeth_lower", "teeth(true)", 0.95, 0.93, 0.85, 0.0, 0.3, "dragon_jaw")
de_s = solid.sphere@1(radius=0.15, segments=14)
de_l = xform.move@1(de_s, by=[0.62, 3.75, 8.45])
de_r = xform.mirror@1(de_l, axis="x")
de_u = solid.union@1(de_l, de_r)
de_m = solid.material@1(de_u, color=[1.0, 0.7, 0.15], roughness=0.2, emissive=[3.4, 1.7, 0.3])
de_p = anim.parent@1(de_m, parent="dragon_head")
output dragon_eyes = de_p
# the wings: the inner arm and its membrane flap at the shoulder, the hand (fingers, outer membrane) bends at the wrist after it; one flap every 2.4 s, the left wing rising on a positive turn about z
def wingside(side, s, sk, wk, sx, wx)
  wb_{side}_s = poly.script@1(code="${jd} wing(0, ${s})")
  wb_{side}_m = solid.material@1(wb_${side}_s, color=[0.4, 0.09, 0.06], roughness=0.55)
  wb_{side}_t = solid.texture@1(wb_${side}_m, tile=2.2, size="512", program="${scales}")
  wb_{side}_a = anim.track@1(wb_${side}_t, property="rotation", keys="${sk}", interpolation="bezier", pivot=[${sx}, 1.7, 2.8])
  wb_{side}_p = anim.parent@1(wb_${side}_a, parent="dragon_body")
  output dragon_wing_arm_{side} = wb_${side}_p
  dleather("dragon_wing_skin_in_${side}", "wing(2, ${s})", "dragon_wing_arm_${side}")
  wo_{side}_s = poly.script@1(code="${jd} wing(1, ${s})")
  wo_{side}_m = solid.material@1(wo_${side}_s, color=[0.4, 0.09, 0.06], roughness=0.55)
  wo_{side}_t = solid.texture@1(wo_{side}_m, tile=2.2, size="512", program="${scales}")
  wo_{side}_a = anim.track@1(wo_{side}_t, property="rotation", keys="${wk}", interpolation="bezier", pivot=[${wx}, 4.2, 3.6])
  wo_{side}_p = anim.parent@1(wo_{side}_a, parent="dragon_wing_arm_${side}")
  output dragon_wing_fingers_{side} = wo_${side}_p
  dleather("dragon_wing_skin_out_${side}", "wing(3, ${s})", "dragon_wing_fingers_${side}")
end
wingside("l", 1, "0:0,0,-6; 0.8:0,0,32; 1.7:0,0,-26; 2.4:0,0,-6", "0:0,0,8; 0.8:0,0,-16; 1.7:0,0,20; 2.4:0,0,8", 1.3, 10.5)
wingside("r", -1, "0:0,0,6; 0.8:0,0,-32; 1.7:0,0,26; 2.4:0,0,6", "0:0,0,-8; 0.8:0,0,16; 1.7:0,0,-20; 2.4:0,0,-8", -1.3, -10.5)

# ---- the fire breath: a tiny shape at the mouth carries the emitter (a stream of bright additive sprites that shrink-grow, cool from yellow to deep red and swirl under turbulence); it is shown only while
# the jaw is open (2.4 to 5.4 s of every 9), and follows the head ----
fire_s = solid.sphere@1(radius=0.1, segments=8)
fire_a = xform.move@1(fire_s, by=[0, 3.2, 10.7])
fire_e = fx.emitter@1(fire_a, name="fire", rate=380, lifetime=[0.8, 1.5], speed=[12, 19], direction=[0, 0, 1], cone=8, shape="point", size=[0.6, 3.0], colour=[1.0, 0.82, 0.35], colour_end=[0.85, 0.12, 0.0], alpha=[1, 0], glow=4, blend="additive", max_particles=6000)
fire_f = fx.force@1(fire_e, kind="turbulence", strength=1.6, scale=1.2)
fire_m = solid.material@1(fire_f, color=[0.1, 0.05, 0.03], roughness=0.8)
fire_v = anim.track@1(fire_m, property="visible", keys="0:0; 2.4:1; 5.4:0; 9:0", interpolation="step")
fire_p = anim.parent@1(fire_v, parent="dragon_head")
output dragon_fire = fire_p

# ---- torches on the castle (a flame, a point light) and smoke from three chimneys ----
def torch(tag, x, y, z)
  tc{tag}_s = solid.box@1(size=[0.18, 0.7, 0.18])
  tc{tag}_a = xform.move@1(tc{tag}_s, by=[{x}, {y}, {z}])
  tc{tag}_e = fx.emitter@1(tc{tag}_a, name="flame", rate=60, lifetime=[0.4, 0.9], speed=[0.8, 1.8], direction=[0, 1, 0], cone=14, shape="disc", extent=[0.12, 0, 0], size=[0.5, 0.08], colour=[1.0, 0.7, 0.2], colour_end=[0.7, 0.08, 0.0], alpha=[1, 0], glow=3, blend="additive", max_particles=200)
  tc{tag}_f = fx.force@1(tc{tag}_e, kind="turbulence", strength=2.0, scale=1.4)
  tc{tag}_m = solid.material@1(tc{tag}_f, color=[0.2, 0.12, 0.06], roughness=0.8)
  output torch_{tag} = tc{tag}_m
  tl_{tag} = light.point@1(position=[{x}, {y + 0.8}, {z}], color=[1.0, 0.7, 0.35], intensity=55, range=20)
end
torch("g1", -3.6, 98.6, 55.4)
torch("g2", 3.6, 98.6, 55.4)
torch("c1", -9, 98.4, 30)
torch("c2", 9, 98.4, 30)
torch("h1", -24, 98.4, 22.5)
torch("k1", 0, 98.4, 10.8)
def smoke(tag, x, y, z)
  sk{tag}_s = solid.sphere@1(radius=0.1, segments=6)
  sk{tag}_a = xform.move@1(sk{tag}_s, by=[{x}, {y}, {z}])
  sk{tag}_e = fx.emitter@1(sk{tag}_a, name="smoke", rate=14, lifetime=[3, 5], speed=[0.6, 1.2], direction=[0.25, 1, 0], cone=12, shape="disc", extent=[0.25, 0, 0], size=[0.5, 3.0], colour=[0.55, 0.55, 0.58], colour_end=[0.45, 0.45, 0.48], alpha=[0.35, 0], blend="alpha", max_particles=300)
  sk{tag}_f = fx.force@1(sk{tag}_e, kind="wind", vector=[1.2, 0, 0.3])
  sk{tag}_m = solid.material@1(sk{tag}_f, color=[0.3, 0.3, 0.3], roughness=0.9)
  output smoke_{tag} = sk{tag}_m
end
smoke("a", -30, 106.5, -25)
smoke("b", 34, 106.5, 10)
smoke("c", -38, 107, -2)

# ---- banners: a crimson pennant on a pole at every tower top and keep turret, each fluttering about its pole on its own phase ----
def banner(tag, x, y, z, ph)
  bn{tag}_s = poly.script@1(code="const m = new Mesh(); const f = (a, b, c) => { m.face(a, b, c); m.face(a, c, b); }; const x = ${x}, y = ${y}, z = ${z}; const p0 = m.vertex(x - 0.07, y, z - 0.07), p1 = m.vertex(x + 0.07, y, z - 0.07), p2 = m.vertex(x, y, z + 0.1), q0 = m.vertex(x - 0.04, y + 6, z - 0.04), q1 = m.vertex(x + 0.04, y + 6, z - 0.04), q2 = m.vertex(x, y + 6, z + 0.06); f(p0, p1, q1); f(p0, q1, q0); f(p1, p2, q2); f(p1, q2, q1); f(p2, p0, q0); f(p2, q0, q2); const a = m.vertex(x, y + 5.9, z), b = m.vertex(x, y + 3.9, z), c = m.vertex(x + 4.2, y + 4.9, z); f(a, b, c); m")
  bn{tag}_m = solid.material@1(bn${tag}_s, color=[0.7, 0.1, 0.12], roughness=0.8)
  bn{tag}_w = anim.wave@1(bn${tag}_m, property="rotation", amplitude=[0, 16, 0], period=1.8, phase={ph}, pivot=[{x}, {y + 5}, {z}])
  output banner_{tag} = bn${tag}_w
end
banner("t0", 50, 129, 0, 0.0)
banner("t1", 35.4, 129, 35.4, 0.14)
banner("t2", -35.4, 129, 35.4, 0.28)
banner("t3", -50, 129, 0, 0.42)
banner("t4", -35.4, 129, -35.4, 0.56)
banner("t5", 0, 129, -50, 0.7)
banner("t6", 35.4, 129, -35.4, 0.84)
banner("g1", -8.5, 132, 50, 0.1)
banner("g2", 8.5, 132, 50, 0.6)
banner("k1", -10, 161, -10, 0.2)
banner("k2", 10, 161, -10, 0.4)
banner("k3", 10, 161, 10, 0.8)
banner("k4", -10, 161, 10, 0.3)
